resource_filename_rule: All emitted Minecraft 1.11 language resources must use lowercase locale filenames such as fr_fr.lang and en_us.lang.

deferred_new_minecraft_codes.io_ido: Ido is a constructed language and is deferred by the project's primary real-world-language scope policy.

persistent_supplement_rule: For the 15 locales that remain incomplete from G6, reuse the exact G6 project supplement values because every English key/value pair is unchanged.
de_de_rule: JEI 4.1.1 de_de is missing 16 keys that JEI 3.14.8 de_DE translated upstream. Reuse those exact pinned G6 upstream translations; do not retranslate them.
sv_se_rule: JEI 4.1.1 sv_se is complete. Emit no addon sv_se file and retire the G6 sv_SE supplement.
debug_keys: Keep target English values for debug-only description.jei.* entries in full addon files; never add debug-only keys to supplements.
norwegian_policy: Minecraft-facing no_no remains a full addon locale. JEI nb_no is preserved independently and is not treated as an alias.
release_rule: Minecraft 1.11 must eventually receive its own dedicated JAR; never combine it with 1.11.2 or another Minecraft version.
